stem: Visible mold-like growth is found on one identified plant during harvest. What should Technician I do?
choices: Blend it into the lot if quantity is small
Follow the supplied hold/isolation procedure and keep the suspect material out of normal flow
Remove the visible portion and record the plant clean
Discard the entire room without authorization
rationale: Follow the supplied hold/isolation procedure and keep the suspect material out of normal flow. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
